purpose: Prevent two distinct absence claims from being silently coerced into positive certification: market-event absence and execution-fallback absence. Add explicit lifecycle boundary authority requirements before D03 eligible-session sets may exclude sessions.

lifecycleBoundaryAuthority.currentRuntimeFinding: twse_regulatory_lifecycle_source_v0_1.mjs can emit an open interval from STOP through coverageTo when no RESUME/termination is observed, while the source itself states absenceCertifiesNoEvent=false.
lifecycleBoundaryAuthority.risk: An uncertified open STOP interval could remove genuinely resumed sessions from the expected eligible-session set, manufacturing history readiness through denominator deletion rather than old-row substitution.

admissibleIntervalStates.rule: STOP plus RESUME or terminal membership boundary are positively certified.
STOP is positively certified and a separate authoritative source proves the suspension remained active through the target date.
STOP exists but closing/active-through boundary authority is incomplete or conflicting.

D03-10.rule: The exact 20 eligible-session denominator may exclude an official non-trading date only when the lifecycle interval covering that date is admissible under boundary authority. An uncertified open STOP may not shorten the 20-session expected set.
D03-10.failureMode: A false exclusion can replace a required resumed trading session with an older close while rowCount remains 20, distorting mean, standard deviation, band width and percent-B.

D03-09.rule: The ordered eligible H/L/C recursion may not omit sessions based on an uncertified open STOP. Only admissible lifecycle exclusions may alter the recursion clock.
D03-09.failureMode: Incorrectly deleting resumed sessions changes TR, +DM/-DM and Wilder smoothing ancestry even if the final sequence length appears valid.

maturityDecision.reason: The exact-session identity and replay-binding mechanics are stronger, but a real continuity receipt and physical independent NC-T01 remain absent. The open-boundary admissibility risk is newly isolated and must remain fail-closed.

exactNextContinuationPoint: Consume whichever lands first: (A) DATA_LANE exact-window TWTAWU bounded-completeness physical receipt plus three TWSE corporate-action exact-range sources, yielding a real CLEAR_NO_ACTION receipt or fail-closed result; or (B) BUILD_LANE CORR-005 hardening with exact-head transitive hidden-fallback audit digest bound into the NC-T01 receipt. After both pre-physical gates pass, consume the real artifact-only NC-T01 S22-T11~T16 receipt.
